acceptanceCriteria: Preserve the exact SwiftPM 6.4 serial XCTest timeout reproduction, incomplete receipt and observed detached XCTest/helper identities; containment is not durable cleanup.

Implement a reviewed bounded teardown mechanism for the supported native SwiftPM tuple that retires task-owned test processes on timeout and interruption without signalling unrelated or reused identities; retain explicit unsupported descendants if ownership cannot be proved.

Pass readiness-marked actual timeout and interruption plus focused lifecycle regression tests, preserving historical plan/receipt bindings and independent review; no complete or passing observation can hide cleanup failure.
body: Confirmed experimental runner cleanup defect discovered during owner-authorized parallel CEM 1.0 qualification. Source/seal 163b46d581228f9cca09482b8e89aff77540897a, installed Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build163, macOS ARM64 SwiftPM 6.4 serial XCTest. Actual fixed Build→Execute invocation used swift-test --enable-xctest --disable-swift-testing --no-parallel --disable-automatic-resolution --skip-update and an exact filter. The readiness-marked test launched a Foundation Process helper. The executor timeout killed its own ordinary group but native xctest PID44873 and sleep PID44874 each occupied a distinct group and survived; xctest was reparented to PID1. The receipt correctly remained incomplete, so this is a descendant-retirement failure rather than a false test pass. The observer retained exact ancestry, start/command identity and emergency-contained only these two owned processes; no survivors remain. Swift interruption was NOT_RUN after the confirmed timeout failure. Reproduction and immutable hashes: /private/tmp/cem10-build/stable-next/native-lifecycle/qualification.json SHA256 f67f44debc8be7581af642a7c4870953ca5bcf3954c3734b6fd57fb43159a11e; swift-xctest-timeout/process-ownership.json SHA256 121846fd78f2954021650acdf79bdec904f053da8f1bb8791fb080ece3bd0c99; freeze.json SHA256 6c55a7e95b4714aa79c2ed567a116395eaf10e877d061d1960290ae4f33b56d6. Source hashes unchanged. Existing V1-0597 concerns lost skipped outcomes and is distinct; V1-0594 is the broader platform release lane. Native SwiftPM/XCTest teardown must be investigated before declaring this tuple lifecycle-qualified.
